title: Plan the indexes of an orders table
brief: The `orders` table (id, customer_id, status, total, created_at) has 50 million rows. The three hot queries are: a customer's recent orders, all orders in status "pending" older than an hour, and one order by id.
deliverables: The CREATE INDEX statements you would add, with the column order justified
Which query each index serves and how you would confirm it with EXPLAIN
What the indexes cost on writes, and one index you chose not to create and why
